TZA.note: The document states nothing on AI harm rules or authorities.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Tanzania's procurement regulator PPRA runs NeST, its e-procurement system, which is powered by AI and applies AI-driven red flags across the procurement cycle.
The World Bank says NeST, Tanzania's public procurement system run by PPRA since July 2023, uses AI-driven red flags and real-time KPI reporting across the procurement cycle.

TZA.note: The document states no national AI model, dataset or computing facility.

facts.fact: The World Bank says PPRA launched the National e-Procurement System NeST on 1 July 2023, and it is in use.
The World Bank says NeST automates every stage of the procurement cycle, from advertising to contract completion, and links 21 other government systems.

TZA.note: Business registration is only named as one of 21 systems NeST links to; nothing on the register itself.

facts.fact: The World Bank says PPRA's own technical staff, more than 40, develop and maintain the NeST e-procurement system.
